name: Recipe Costing and Food Cost Calculator
h1: Recipe Costing and Food Cost Calculator
title: Recipe Costing and Food Cost Calculator for Restaurants (Free)
description: Add ingredients, waste and portions to see the cost per portion, food cost percentage and gross profit of any dish. Free, runs in your browser.
lead: List the ingredients of a dish and see exactly what one portion costs you.
intro: A dish can look profitable and still lose money because the cost of ingredients, trimming and waste adds up. Recipe costing shows what one portion really costs.

Enter the quantity of each ingredient and its price per unit from your own supplier bills. Add an allowance for waste and the number of portions the recipe makes. Add your menu price to see the food cost percentage. Nothing is uploaded.
how: Ingredient cost = quantity used x price per unit.
Recipe cost = sum of ingredient costs x (1 + waste %).
Cost per portion = recipe cost / portions.
Food cost % = cost per portion / menu price.
example: A recipe uses 0.5 kg of meat at Rs. 800 per kg (Rs. 400) and 2 kg of other items at Rs. 100 (Rs. 200). With 10% waste the cost is Rs. 660. It makes 4 portions, so Rs. 165 each. At a menu price of Rs. 400 the food cost is 41.3%.
mistakes: Forgetting trimming, cooking loss and spoilage.
Leaving out oil, spices and garnish.
Mixing units, such as grams with a price per kilogram.

faq.q: What is a good food cost percentage?
faq.a: It depends on the type of restaurant and your other costs. Set your own target with the Menu Pricing tool.
